name: Among the Dead
source:
Among the Dead - is an episodic choice-based visual novel about life after the zombie apocalypse. You need to fight with zombies and make decisions which can affect the further story. This is the first episode.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/774451/]Steam[/url]]
